latest.title: Minimal-Volume Equiangular Hyperbolic $4$-Polytopes
latest.abstract: We study finite-volume convex hyperbolic $4$-polytopes whose dihedral angles are all equal to a fixed strictly acute angle $α$. Put $α_0=\arccos(1/3)$ and $α_1=\arccos(1/4)$. We first show that the class is empty for $α<α_0$. For $α_0\leqα<α_1$, the unique polytope of minimum volume is the regular hyperbolic $4$-simplex with dihedral angle $α$. As $α$ increases to $α_1$, this simplex degenerates to a Euclidean one and no hyperbolic simplex exists at $α_1$. For $α_1\leqα<π/2$, the unique minimum is the regular equiangular hyperbolic $4$-cube. The proof combines the hyperbolic Gram--Euler relation with the Davis--Okun theorem on the Charney--Davis inequality for flag triangulations of the $3$-sphere. The geometric step is a missing-face argument showing that the boundary of the dual of every nonsimplex in the class is flag.
latest.workSummary: 确定固定严格锐二面角的有限体积双曲四维多胞体何时存在，并分角度区间给出唯一最小体积者：正单纯形或正四维立方体。
latest.breakthrough: 把体积极值归结到对偶边界的组合性质，呈现由单纯形转向立方体的临界角现象。
latest.limitations: 结论限于四维、等二面角且严格锐角的凸多胞体；不能外推到一般多胞体。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。
